After deciding to uninstall this app, I cancelled my subscription after only two days. Fast-forward a week and I get an email saying I've been billed for another week of use for this app, even though I had unsubscribed. I contacted Apple and they agreed that I had unsubscribed and I should not have been billed. Immediate 1 star for shady business practices. AVOID THIS APP! TL;DR - Avoid this app and it'a "free trial". They will bill you even if you have unsubscribed and you will have to contact Apple to unsubscribe.
